name: When should I schedule a roofing project planning consultation?

mainEntity.name: When should I schedule a roofing project planning consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should schedule a roofing project planning consultation if you notice signs of damage, such as missing shingles, leaks, or granule loss, or if your roof is over 15-20 years old. It's also wise to get a consultation after severe weather events common in the DFW area, even without obvious damage. Proactive consultations can identify issues early, potentially saving significant repair costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule a consultation for visible damage, an aging roof (15-20+ years), or after severe weather, especially in the DFW area.
